name: Shatter Point 7/5/11

date.source: the document's own title and dateline ("SHATTER POINT 7/5/11") plus the fed's own archive index, which names each show by its own date

appearances.note: Parking-lot ambush of the Home Town Heroes with Ezra Mayhem before the broadcast; confronted the champions again backstage during their title celebration.
Parking-lot ambush of the Home Town Heroes with Jakob Mayhem before the broadcast; confronted the champions again backstage during their title celebration.
Fought off the Mayhem Brothers' parking-lot ambush, then celebrated the Home Town Heroes' Tag Team Championship win before Total Mayhem interrupted.
Fought off the Mayhem Brothers' parking-lot ambush, then celebrated the Home Town Heroes' Tag Team Championship win before Total Mayhem interrupted.
Helped fight off the Mayhem Brothers' parking-lot ambush and hosted the Home Town Heroes' title celebration, alongside her own match earlier in the night.
Superkicked and driven face-first into a title briefcase by SNA (Nick Alexander) partway through the show, ending his night.
Took over ring-announcing duties after Maxwell Fabian was assaulted by SNA.
Officiated the Payne/Johnson vs. El Fuego tag match, including ejecting Jackson Cage and Leonard Jenkins' entourage roles from ringside.

Handed SNA (Nick Alexander) his International Championship contract, granted Edward Croft a tournament (the Quest for Glory), and booked Xavier Reid against Mike King and the Home Town Heroes for the following week.
Sat ringside as a self-declared fan through most of the card, interfered in the McNeil/King match with a chair shot, then burned an American flag and was arrested.
Led the security team that tried and failed to keep Xavier Reid out of the arena, then arrested him after the flag-burning.
Ejected from ringside by referee Chris Young ahead of the Payne/Johnson vs. El Fuego tag match; chased Waylon Krews through the crowd after the Underground Championship changed hands.
Cut a promo on Cassandra Avery, received his guaranteed International Championship shot from Frankie Manning, then superkicked Maxwell Fabian and drove him face-first into the title briefcase.
Confronted SNA (Nick Alexander) over an old relationship before wrestling in the International Championship #1 contender's match the same night.
Arrived with Ryan Shane and Ms. Fontaine, then closed the show naming Crimson Blaze as his first Heavyweight Championship challenger.

Arrived with Justin Marsham and Ms. Fontaine, declared himself the first EWA Innovation Champion, was ambushed by Ronnie McNeil, and later distracted McNeil from the entrance screens during the McNeil/King match.
Produced the Innovation Championship belt from a black velvet bag for Ryan Shane.
Snatched the new Innovation Championship out of Ryan Shane's hands and threw it back at him before his own match with Mike King.
Tried to interview Xavier Reid and became the target of his open mic instead.
Hosted the in-fiction Casting Couch awards segment crowning Chris Johnson Greatest Underground Champion of All Time.
Hosted the Casting Couch, crowning himself Greatest Underground Champion of All Time, before Waylon Krews interrupted to reclaim his own title shot.
Threw the pimp cane from ringside that let Marcellus Payne turn the El Fuego tag match.
Backstage with La Diva Gaga and Chris Tolwar, restating his mission to bring lucha libre respect to the promotion through Los Compania Olvidados de Mal.
Backstage with Mike King and Chris Tolwar after his own win over Jeremy Hunter.
Backstage with Mike King and La Diva Gaga, waiting on a place in Los Compania Olvidados de Mal.

notes: The only Shatter Point results document that survives for this promotion, recovered from the fed's own second domain, ewaresults.webs.com, via its one surviving Wayback capture. The other three Shatter Point dates the fed's own site named (7/20, 8/2, 8/16/11) remain uncollected; the Wayback Machine never crawled any of their own results pages.

matches.note: Sons of Ohio ambushed The Wreckers before the bell and never let up; the Southern Express made the save after the pinfall.

Ended without a clean finish: Ryan Shane distracted Ronnie McNeil from the entrance screens and Mike King hit the Metallica Knee Kick, then Xavier Reid jumped the rail with a chair and took Mike King out before any pinfall — no winner recorded.

Waylon Krews ran in on the Payne/Johnson vs. El Fuego tag match, hit the Krewsplitter on legal man Chris Johnson onto a steel chair, and the referee counted the pin under the belt's own 24/7 rules — the tag match itself continued around it.

Chris Johnson pinned Crimson Blaze after a chair shot to the face while Marcellus Payne held El Pablo's team-mate off; a mid-match run-in cost Chris Johnson the Underground Championship (see the Krews/Johnson match) without affecting this match's own outcome.
